text: Let me show you how to make a protein packed, healthy and delicious dense bean salad, extra virgin olive oil, lemon zest and juice, vinegar, dried oregano, honey and mustard. Add chickpeas, black beans and candelini beans. Let them marinate while you chop the veggies. Cherry tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, scallions, parsley and crumbled feta. Toss it all together. Easy, right?
